name: cds-access
title_zh: 哥白尼数据下载前先过许可和排队这关
tagline_zh: ERA5-Land 和 C3S 季节预报的下载总是卡在许可没点、请求排队、任务莫名消失？它把认证。
tagline_en: Stops ERA5-Land and C3S seasonal downloads from dying at licence prompts, queued requests, or vanished.
desc_en: Copernicus Climate Data Store access - authentication, licence acceptance, seasonal forecast requests, queue behaviour. Use when downloading ERA5-Land or C3S seasonal forecast data.
why_zh: 它不替你选变量或画图，只把 CDS 的认证、许可、请求和队列行为讲清楚。
why_en: It doesn't pick variables or plot maps—it nails CDS auth, licence acceptance, request submission, and queue behaviour so your.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Copernicus CDS 的认证、许可、季节预报请求和队列；不处理 ERA5 之外的任何数据源。
limit_en: Only covers Copernicus CDS auth, licences, seasonal forecast requests, and queues; no other data sources, no variable selection, post-processing, or.
title_en: Copernicus CDS access: auth, licences, queues
